rooms.name: Time Office
rooms.role: entry: the way in and out; the first cache; a breath before the works

rooms.name: Stockhouse and Ore Bridge
rooms.role: branch: up the stair to the ore bridge and the upper ring; bunker chutes overhead

rooms.name: Pattern Shop
rooms.role: side room: the machine room (chip, med proposed); a quiet loop to the rolling mill

rooms.name: Casting Floor
rooms.role: arena: the big fights under the ladle crane, ringed by the upper catwalks

rooms.name: Furnace Aisle and Charging Deck
rooms.role: arena edge: three furnace mouths on the deck, tapholes and runners below

rooms.name: Rolling Mill
rooms.role: lane fight: a 60 m hall split by the roller table and four stands

rooms.name: Coke Oven Battery
rooms.role: choke: two lanes along the oven doors, the pusher car, the quench tower

rooms.name: Converter Hall
rooms.role: boss arena placeholder: three ways in, two converters, the pouring pit

rooms.name: Slag Yard and Drop Forge
rooms.role: risk and reward: the slag dump, the drop hammer, the third cache
